svg.title: Insuring the Rental Operation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-insuring-the-rental-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Insuring the Rental Operation; subtitle: From the conversion call to scheduled portfolio coverage; caption: Four steps that move a property off a homeowner policy and onto landlord coverage, with disclosure, liability, and evidence gates.; assumptions note: Week labels order the practitioner gates; no speaker testified to specific durations beyond the 15-minute conversion call. Premium figures are a Michigan quote and a national estimate.; note: Drawn from Real Property Management Palisade (aUKpl6xobwU), Hannigan Insurance Agency (aGvo7Dq3gTM), Steadily (8qVhmrP1DZM), The CoLiving Insider (RyLyOzBiWEs), Blue Fox Properties (7sscnFcWkp4), Jacob and Elissa (ZoPbBZvfW94), and AmericanModernIns (fR49bewBEuo).; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Make the conversion call; deliverable: A 15-minute call telling the agent the address is becoming a rental, before the tenant moves in.; gate: Policy rewritten for tenant occupancy; the failure mode is a denied claim.; week: Week 2; title: Rewrite as a landlord policy; deliverable: Dwelling fire pushed to DP3 with replacement cost, loss of rent, vandalism, and water; about $1,200 a year versus $895 in Michigan, about 25 percent more per Steadily.; gate: Named insured matches how the home is deeded, including an LLC.; week: Week 3; title: Disclose exact use and stack liability; deliverable: Written disclosure of rent-by-the-room use and at least $500,000 in liability; Lopez v. Allstate rescinded a policy on an about $371,000 loss.; gate: Every change in rooms or guest type reported before renewal.; week: Week 4; title: Safety fixes and damage evidence; deliverable: Working smoke alarms, no dual cylinder deadbolts, screens on operable windows, and cleaner photos before every check-in and after every checkout.; gate: Scaled portfolios consolidate up to 30 homes on one bill and renewal date.
